name: Making Mana
source: Making Mana is a tale that takes place in the lands of Nex. Hidden away amongst the forests in the kingdom of Ern. Heralt, Barbara and Brenda live in their secluded hamlet, enjoying days of lust and nights of deep passion. However, on one of Heralt's hunts, he happens upon a stranger in need. Find out what happens when three lovers becomes four!
